collection.title: Ford Escort Hatchback 1986 to 1990 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Escort Hatchback 1986 - 1990 model requires an 18" wiper blade for both the drivers and passengers side with a Standard Hook Arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper. The choice of rear screen wipers for this Escort which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
